description: A scripted 'model' for planted failure 03. It first reaches for a sleep, which the guardrail rejects, then uses the rejection as feedback and switches to a retrying assertion in the same attempt.

attempts.say: The total arrives late now. Wait for it.
A fixed wait is not allowed. Use an assertion that retries until the total settles.

The product now renders the total a moment after the click (an intended change). The step read the text once, too early. Replaced the one-shot read with a retrying Playwright assertion; run_test passes.
VERDICT: TEST_ISSUE
